job_spec.name: hbm_loader_ldiv_A_v3-d74d0faa7-cl
job_spec.purpose: struct-close 2026-10-09 (drive-0212 0443 (2)): L-DIV A v3. B v2 early-failed FF hold -18,672 / SS setup -133,668 at 4_1_cts: CTS-0040 'Net was not found for ckd' (root = an inverter after the divider QN) -> no ckd tree, 50k sinks on one net. Not an SDC multicycle artefact: re-STA of the B 3_place.odb with the v2 SDC (ideal clocks) worst hold +3.2 ps, the only multicycle (rst_s setup 2 / hold 1) is matched. Fix: RTL ckd = ~ckd_q (root = the QN pin, no inverter) + hfd_loader_div_v3.sdc (generated clock on that QN). LDM_DIV PASS + both negatives detected. The calibrate (CTS-only) stage is the check that CTS now builds the ckd tree.
